title: 微流道晶片冷卻
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入微流道對流、壓降、熱點與泵功；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine microchannel convection, pressure drop, hotspots and pump power. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。單相穩態水流算例不涵蓋沸騰、氣泡堵塞與冷卻液材料相容性；製作和加壓測試需專業設備。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Single-phase steady-water examples exclude boiling, bubble blockage and coolant compatibility; fabrication and pressurized testing require professional equipment.

stages.title: 熱液需求
stages.description: 本階段處理熱液需求：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address thermal-fluid requirements through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 定義熱通量分布
steps.titleEn: Define heat-flux distribution
steps.objective: 建立「定義熱通量分布」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：熱點位置比平均功率更能決定通道需求，上游與下游溫差也不可忽略。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for define heat-flux distribution: Hotspot locations can govern channel needs more strongly than average power; upstream-downstream gradients matter.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫一個集中熱點，分別置於入口及出口比較。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Place the same hotspot near inlet and outlet and compare. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫一個集中熱點，分別置於入口及出口比較。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Place the same hotspot near inlet and outlet and compare. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：通道愈窄總系統能耗必定愈低。本步先檢查「定義熱通量分布」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到熱點位置比平均功率更能決定通道需求，上游與下游溫差也不可忽略。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Narrower channels always reduce total system energy. First check whether evidence for define heat-flux distribution actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Hotspot locations can govern channel needs more strongly than average power; upstream-downstream gradients matter.
steps.check: 交付「定義熱通量分布」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for define heat-flux distribution, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「微流道晶片冷卻」的「定義熱通量分布」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「熱島救援：模組交付前夜」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Define heat-flux distribution” in “Microchannel chip cooling”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Thermal Island: Before Module Delivery” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.titleEn: Identify flow regime: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「辨識流動區域」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the identify flow regime model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。從截面面積與潤濕周長算 Dh=4A/P。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Compute Dh=4A/P from cross-sectional area and wetted perimeter. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：從截面面積與潤濕周長算 Dh=4A/P。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compute Dh=4A/P from cross-sectional area and wetted perimeter. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：冷卻液出口溫度就是晶片最高溫度。本步先檢查「辨識流動區域」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到雷諾數需使用水力直徑及平均速度，矩形通道不能直接用寬度代替所有尺度。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Coolant outlet temperature equals peak chip temperature. First check whether evidence for identify flow regime actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Reynolds number uses hydraulic diameter and mean velocity; channel width alone is insufficient.
steps.check: 交付「辨識流動區域」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for identify flow regime: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.
